name: PropertyWatch — Property Monitoring Demo
description: Deterministic synthetic reference profile for the MultiSens v0.7 deployment/resource-tradeoff workflow. PropertyWatch is a personal multi-camera property monitoring setup - a home, garage, workshop, storage space, or small warehouse, never one hardcoded building type - with no surveillance-identification or face-recognition features of any kind. Reference sensor ids (property_entrance_rgb, property_storage_rgb, property_indoor_rgb) are three separate physical camera positions, never merged just because they share a modality. SYNTHETIC DATA - demonstrates functionality only, not a claim about real camera performance. See examples/profiles/README.md.

requirements.name: Entrance area visible
requirements.description: Can this configuration see the entrance area?

requirements.name: Storage area visible
requirements.description: Can this configuration see the storage/garage/workshop area? Genuinely N/A (not fail) for any configuration that never included a storage-facing camera at all.

requirements.name: Indoor area visible
requirements.description: Can this configuration see the indoor/hallway area? Genuinely N/A for any configuration without an indoor-facing camera.

requirements.name: Entrance reliability, stricter bar
requirements.description: A stricter accuracy bar on the same entrance area - representing reduced-lighting/edge-case reliability, reachable only by the fully-equipped configuration in this demo.
